title: Saudi Arabia orders probe into Jeddah water tank collapse
summary: Dubai: Saudi authorities have ordered an investigation into the collapse of a large water tank in Jeddah, which sent a torrent of water rushing across the surrounding area, according to local media reports. Prince Khalid Al Faisal, Adviser to the Custodian of the Two Holy Mosques and Governor of the Mecca Region, directed the formation of a committee comprising relevant authorities to investigate the circumstances and causes of the incident, the Mecca Governorate said on Wednesday. title: Emirates Specialty Hospital opens dedicated chemotherapy unit in Dubai
summary: Emirates Specialty Hospital in Dubai Healthcare City has announced the opening of a dedicated chemotherapy unit within its Emirates Oncology Centre, marking an expansion of its cancer care services and strengthening access to specialised oncology treatment for patients in Dubai. The newly established unit has been designed to provide chemotherapy treatments in a dedicated clinical setting, with an emphasis on patient safety, individualised treatment plans and continuous medical support throughout the cancer care journey.
